# Grok conformance corpora

Corpora in this directory are generated by `scripts/grok-conformance-proxy.mjs`
and used as strict record/replay contracts for the browser port.

Raw JSONL corpora are deliberately git-ignored and created with mode `0600`.
Canonical request headers redact credentials and symbolize account identifiers,
but response bytes and model prompts are intentionally preserved for byte-exact
local replay. Never commit or share a recorded corpus. Only synthetic fixtures
belong in version control.

Replay fails closed on the first request difference. A successful browser run
must also call `POST /__conformance__/assert-complete`; that endpoint fails if
even one native exchange was not reproduced.
